# OFF MARKET

OFF MARKET is a private real estate advisory based in Marrakech, Morocco.
The public website presents confidential residential opportunities, off-plan projects,
and the S.A.F.E. selection methodology used before a property is introduced.

## Primary public pages

- Home: https://offmarketofficial.com/
- About / S.A.F.E. methodology: https://offmarketofficial.com/about/
- Off-plan projects: https://offmarketofficial.com/sur-plan/
- Projects: https://offmarketofficial.com/nos-projets/
- Neighbourhoods: https://offmarketofficial.com/quartiers/
- Private access (Off Market): https://offmarketofficial.com/off-market/
- Contact: https://offmarketofficial.com/contact/
- Blog: https://offmarketofficial.com/blog/
- Investment simulator: https://offmarketofficial.com/simulateur/

## Supported languages

- French (default): https://offmarketofficial.com/
- English: https://offmarketofficial.com/en/
- Italian: https://offmarketofficial.com/it/
- Dutch: https://offmarketofficial.com/nl/
- Spanish: https://offmarketofficial.com/es/
- Norwegian: https://offmarketofficial.com/no/

Localized equivalents of the pages above are available under each language prefix
(for example `/en/about/`, `/it/chi-siamo/`, `/nl/over-ons/`).

## Notes for agents

- Prefer publicly linked pages and published project information only.
- Do not invent inventory, pricing, or private listing details that are not on the site.
- Contact and private-access forms are the intended path for acquisition inquiries.
